_comment: Engine kits (roadmap step 40): an engine build's parts in one crate. kits.size.<id> names a size of engine_kits.json
(kits.size.used a used kit, an engine taken apart); kits.name {size} that and {engine} the engine's name (a complete
kit's build, a smaller one's block). kits.detail.new.* {parts} how many parts, {build} the build they are of,
{count} how many on the shelf; kits.detail.used {parts} and {wear} their average condition in percent;
kits.detail.whole and kits.detail.missing {detail} that line and {missing} the parts it comes without.
paper.ad.kit.headline {engine}; paper.kit.confirm {kit} the kit as kits.name says it, {price}, {seller}.
